body.text: Teknoppy redesigns outdated or slow websites in Kochi without losing Google rankings. We audit your current site, map every URL with 301 redirects, rebuild it mobile-first for speed, and monitor rankings after launch. Most redesigns take 4-8 weeks.

Kochi businesses come to us when their current site was built years ago, was never mobile-friendly, or has fallen behind competitors who modernized first. Every redesign starts with an audit of what is actually broken across the site before a single design decision is made.

sections.intro: The biggest fear of redesigning a website is losing existing Google rankings and traffic. Here is our exact 5-step SEO migration safeguard:

items.html: 1. Pre-Redesign URL Crawl: We audit and catalogue every existing URL, meta title, heading structure, and ranking keyword currently delivering traffic.
2. Comprehensive 301 Redirect Mapping: Every legacy URL is mapped to its exact new counterpart, ensuring zero broken 404 links for users or search bots.
3. Content & Keyword Architecture Preservation: Core ranking copy, internal link hubs, and semantic heading hierarchies are preserved and optimized.
4. Staging Verification Before Launch: We test all redirects, canonical tags, and schema markup on a password-protected staging site before DNS cutover.
5. Post-Launch Search Console Monitoring: We submit the updated XML sitemap and monitor Google Search Console for 30–60 days to verify smooth indexation.

items.title: Site Audit & Goal Setting (Week 1)
items.text: We analyze your current site's speed, traffic channels, conversion bottlenecks, and competitor positioning to establish clear KPIs.

items.title: Information Architecture & SEO Mapping (Weeks 2–3)
items.text: We map out the new sitemap, page hierarchies, and 301 redirect strategy, ensuring every high-value organic ranking is protected.

items.title: UI/UX Design & Prototyping (Weeks 3–4)
items.text: Modern wireframes and high-fidelity Figma prototypes designed mobile-first around conversion goals.

items.title: Development & Core Web Vitals Optimization (Weeks 5–6)
items.text: Clean coding on Astro, WordPress, or modern frameworks, engineered for sub-second load times and passing Core Web Vitals.

items.title: Launch & Search Console Monitoring (Weeks 7–8)
items.text: Seamless zero-downtime cutover during low-traffic hours, accompanied by post-launch indexing and rank tracking.

sections.h2: Does Your Website Need a Redesign?
sections.intro: If your site displays three or more of the following warning signs, a structured redesign will deliver immediate commercial returns:

items.text: Age: The website is more than 3 to 4 years old and looks outdated compared to modern competitors.
Mobile Performance: The site is slow, fails Core Web Vitals, or is difficult to read on mobile phones.
Content Management: Updating basic text, pricing, or projects requires contacting an external programmer.
Declining Conversions: Traffic has remained flat or inquiries have steadily dropped over recent quarters.
Brand Disconnect: The website no longer reflects your current service offerings, team scale, or enterprise credentials.

items.q: Will a website redesign affect my current SEO rankings?
items.a: Not when executed properly. We audit all current ranking URLs, maintain existing on-page keyword signals, and implement a comprehensive 301 redirect map. Following our SEO migration protocols, rankings typically improve due to faster speeds and cleaner site architecture.

items.q: How much does a website redesign cost in Kochi?
items.a: A design refresh modernizing existing pages typically costs ₹25,000 to ₹55,000. A comprehensive architectural rebuild with content migration ranges from ₹55,000 to ₹1,20,000+. We provide a fixed quote after auditing your current site.

items.q: Will my domain and email accounts change during a redesign?
items.a: No. Your domain name and corporate email hosting (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, cPanel) remain completely unchanged. We switch only the website files during a planned low-traffic cutover window.

items.q: Can you reuse our existing content and images?
items.a: Yes. We preserve all high-performing articles, product descriptions, and media assets. Outdated content is rewritten or pruned, with 301 redirects mapped to maintain user experience and search equity.

items.q: Can you redesign an ecommerce website without losing order history?
items.a: Yes. Customer databases, product catalogs, and order history are migrated with zero data loss. See our dedicated Ecommerce Redesign & Migration Services in Kochi for store rebuilds.

items.q: How long does a website redesign project take?
items.a: Most business website redesigns take 4 to 8 weeks from initial audit to final launch, depending on page volume and custom feature requirements.

items.q: Do you redesign websites built by other agencies or freelancers?
items.a: Yes. Most of our redesign clients come to us with legacy sites built by previous developers. We begin every engagement with an objective technical audit regardless of who originally created the site.
